description: Überschwemmungsgebiete Sachsen-Anhalt (WMS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by lvwa.themenbrowser.de. According to § 76 WHG, flooding areas are areas of above-ground waters and dikes or floods and other areas that are flooded or flowed in the event of floods of an above-ground water or which are claimed for flood relief or retention. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding areas Saxony-Anhalt (WMS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasser, Wassergüte, Überschwemmungsgebiete. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
